hunks.baseline: The instant dozens of whiskers were torn out all at once by Jin Taekyung, the Mutated Water God Dragon opened wide the one eye it had left.
hunks.sol: The instant Jin Taekyung ripped out dozens of whiskers at once, the Mutated Water God Dragon opened wide its one remaining eye.

hunks.baseline: That some tiny, insignificant human had torn out its whiskers—and with his bare hands, without even a weapon.
hunks.sol: That tiny, insignificant human had torn out its whiskers—with his bare hands, without even a weapon.

hunks.baseline: It was something that could not happen and should never have happened. Even for the Water God Dragon, which had lived for hundreds of years, it was a shocking first.
hunks.sol: It was impossible. It should have been impossible. Even for the Water God Dragon, which had lived for hundreds of years, this was a shocking first.

hunks.baseline: And then, in the next moment, the Water God Dragon realized something.
hunks.sol: Then, in the next moment, the Water God Dragon realized something.

hunks.baseline: The human who had ripped out its whiskers using nothing but pure physical strength was completely fucking insane.
hunks.sol: The human who had ripped out its whiskers through sheer physical strength was completely fucking insane.

hunks.baseline: “Baldy!”
hunks.sol: “Bald head!”

hunks.sol: *Pop!*

hunks.baseline: “Bald!”
hunks.sol: “Baldy!”

hunks.baseline: *Ppobok!*
hunks.sol: *Pop-pop!*

hunks.baseline: “Smooth, shiny, shaved head!”
hunks.sol: “Smooth, shiny baldy!”

hunks.baseline: *Ppobobobobok!*
hunks.sol: *Pop-pop-pop-pop-pop!*

hunks.baseline: A scream rising from the depths of its soul.
hunks.sol: A scream rose from the depths of its soul.

hunks.baseline: The Mutated Water God Dragon thrashed about, howling in agony. For some reason, it did not know why, but the pain and sorrow welling up inside it were dozens of times greater than when it had first lost its eye.
hunks.sol: The Mutated Water God Dragon thrashed and howled in agony. For some inexplicable reason, the pain and sorrow surging through it were dozens of times worse than when it had first lost its eye.

hunks.baseline: It had to get this mad human off it as soon as possible.
hunks.sol: It had to get this mad human off it as quickly as possible.

hunks.baseline: But unlike the Water God Dragon’s desperate wish, Jin Taekyung had no intention of stopping.
hunks.sol: But despite the Water God Dragon’s desperate wish, Jin Taekyung had no intention of stopping.

hunks.baseline: After driving the spearhead between the scales covering the bridge of its nose and pinning himself in place, Jin Taekyung spoke in a sinister voice.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung drove the spearhead between the scales covering the bridge of its nose, anchoring himself in place, and spoke in a sinister voice.

hunks.baseline: “Because you don’t have two feet. Hell, you don’t even have two hairs.”
hunks.sol: “Because you don’t have two feet.”[^1]

hunks.baseline: *Ppobobobobobok!*
hunks.sol: *Pop-pop-pop-pop-pop!*

hunks.baseline: “Even if you multiplied together all the fur belonging to every spirit beast in the world, the result would still be zero. Because you don’t have any fur. You just don’t. You don’t have a goddamn single hair!”
hunks.sol: “Multiply the number of hairs on every spiritual creature in the world together and you still get zero. Because you don’t have any hair. You just don’t. You don’t have a single goddamn hair!”

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung’s hands were more ruthless than ever.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung’s methods were more ruthless than ever.

hunks.baseline: Whenever the whiskers flew toward him in a tangled mass to attack, he caught them with one hand and yanked them out like weeds. Iron-hard skin split open, and whiskers tougher and sharper than Heavenly Silkworm Thread were ripped out in their entirety.
hunks.sol: Whenever the whiskers flew at him in a tangled mass, he caught them with one hand and yanked them out like weeds. Iron-hard skin split open, and the whiskers—tougher and sharper than Heavenly Silkworm Thread—were ripped out by the roots.

hunks.baseline: Every last one of them. Without leaving even a single strand behind.
hunks.sol: Every last one of them. Not a single strand remained.

hunks.baseline: Even through the reason clouded like a sky hidden behind storm clouds, the Mutated Water God Dragon was consumed by furious rage and sorrow.
hunks.sol: Even through its reason, now as murky as a sky smothered by storm clouds, the Mutated Water God Dragon was consumed by overwhelming rage and sorrow.

hunks.baseline: What kind of whiskers were these?
They had grown alongside it for hundreds of years. They were practically companions of its soul.
hunks.sol: Those whiskers had grown alongside it for hundreds of years. They were companions to its very soul.

hunks.baseline: They were excellent weapons with which to destroy intruders who harbored impudent thoughts, as well as symbols of its power and majesty.
hunks.sol: They were excellent weapons for destroying intruders who harbored impudent thoughts, and symbols of its power and majesty.

hunks.baseline: And now those whiskers were gone. They had been pulled out helplessly, like weak and useless seaweed.
hunks.sol: And now they were gone. They had been pulled out as helplessly as weak, useless seaweed.

hunks.baseline: And by the hands of a human much smaller and more insignificant than itself!
hunks.sol: By the hands of a human far smaller and more insignificant than itself!

hunks.baseline: A savage roar that shook heaven and earth.
hunks.sol: A savage roar shook heaven and earth.

hunks.baseline: When the master who had ruled Dongting Lake and the Yangtze for hundreds of years began to radiate a baleful aura, everything around it held its breath.
hunks.sol: As the master that had ruled Dongting Lake and the Yangtze for hundreds of years radiated its baleful presence, everything around it held its breath.

hunks.baseline: No. Everything changed according to its anger.
hunks.sol: No. Everything changed in response to its fury.

hunks.baseline: It was a truly frightening and bizarre sight. Lightning struck without pause from the sky, which was covered in unusually thick black clouds, while rain poured down in a deluge unlike anything seen in the past fifty years.
hunks.sol: It was a truly frightening and bizarre sight. Lightning struck without pause from a sky shrouded in unusually thick black clouds, while rain poured down in a deluge unlike anything seen in the past fifty years.

hunks.baseline: The river, swollen several times over by the abnormal weather that had continued for several shichen, formed whirlpools of every size that circled around the Water God Dragon.
hunks.sol: Swollen several times over by the abnormal weather of the past several shichen, the river formed whirlpools large and small that circled the Water God Dragon.

hunks.baseline: And in the middle of that landscape, which resembled a minor catastrophe, stood an enormous body towering like an iron monument.
hunks.sol: At the heart of that scene, which resembled a minor catastrophe, its enormous body towered like an iron pagoda.

hunks.baseline: At the sight of the monster, its eye glowing with an entirely blood-red light, the people on the ground let out quiet groans.
hunks.sol: At the sight of the monster, its eye glowing bloodred, the people on the ground groaned quietly.

hunks.baseline: “Damn it. This old man really has lived a long time. I never thought I’d see something this absurd.”
hunks.sol: “Damn it. This old man really has lived a long time. I never thought I’d see something so absurd.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang and Mungyeong stared at the unbelievable scene with stunned expressions.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang and Mungyeong stared at the unbelievable scene in astonishment.

hunks.baseline: They had long known that beings called spirit beasts and evil beasts possessed astonishing power, but the sight unfolding before them was far beyond anything they had imagined.
hunks.sol: They had long known that beings called spiritual creatures and evil creatures possessed astonishing power, but what was unfolding before them lay far beyond anything they had imagined.

hunks.baseline: And that was not all. Plants, trees, mountains, and rivers held their breath beneath the baleful aura pouring from it, while lightning and water responded to its fury.
hunks.sol: And that was not all. Mountains, rivers, plants, and trees held their breath beneath its surging baleful presence, while lightning and water responded to its fury.

hunks.baseline: Things of the strange, prodigious force, rebellion, and ghosts.
hunks.sol: Strange phenomena, feats of strength, disorder, and spirits.

hunks.baseline: It was exactly what those four characters meant.
hunks.sol: Everything embodied by that four-character phrase was unfolding before them.

hunks.baseline: Uncanny beings and phenomena beyond the understanding of even two men who had spent most of their lives in the Murim were unfolding before them.
hunks.sol: An inexplicable being and phenomena beyond the understanding of even two men who had spent long years in the Murim were appearing before their eyes.

hunks.baseline: The sound of flesh being torn was clearly audible even amid the thunder and lightning.
hunks.sol: The sound of flesh tearing rang out clearly even amid the thunder and lightning.

hunks.baseline: The next moment, scales drenched in dark-blue blood poured down over Jeok Cheongang and Mungyeong’s heads.
hunks.sol: The next moment, scales drenched in dark-blue blood poured down from above Jeok Cheongang and Mungyeong.

hunks.baseline: Soon, dozens of scales began to patter down like a sudden shower.
hunks.sol: Soon, dozens of scales pattered down like a sudden shower.

hunks.baseline: With eyesight like birds of prey, the two men saw what was happening high above them and were rendered speechless.
hunks.sol: With eyesight like birds of prey, the two men saw what was happening high above and were rendered speechless.

hunks.baseline: “Let’s see the flesh underneath! Let’s see what’s inside!”
hunks.sol: “Flesh! Let’s see the flesh underneath!”

hunks.baseline: Along with a crazed shout, a young man moved his hands like a madman.
hunks.sol: A young man shouted like a lunatic as his hands moved furiously.

hunks.baseline: One hand gripped the shaft of his spear with all his strength. The other held no weapon at all as his bare hand seized a scale.
hunks.sol: One hand gripped the shaft of his spear with all his strength. The other held no weapon at all as his bare fingers seized a scale.

hunks.baseline: The scale tore free helplessly, trailing dark-blue blood.
hunks.sol: The scale tore free with a spray of dark-blue blood.

hunks.baseline: Whenever it sensed something was wrong, Jin Taekyung darted like a ghost into the empty socket where its eye had melted away. Once the monster’s rampage ended, he popped his head back out and resumed his work.
hunks.sol: Whenever it showed signs of attacking, Jin Taekyung darted like a ghost into the hollow socket where its eye had melted away. Once the monster’s rampage ended, he popped his head back out and resumed his work.

hunks.baseline: The Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist, one of the five most destructive techniques among the Fire Gate Clan’s various secret arts, combined with strength tremendous enough to call him superhuman.
hunks.sol: The Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist, one of the five most destructive techniques among the Fire Gate Clan’s secret arts, combined with strength tremendous enough to be called superhuman.

hunks.baseline: The monster’s head, nearly the size of an average ship, shook violently, and shattered scales rained down.
hunks.sol: The monster’s head, nearly the size of an average ship, shook violently as shattered scales rained down.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps because it had smashed its head against the cliff so many times, it was beginning to feel dizzy.
hunks.sol: Perhaps because it had smashed its head against the cliff so many times, it was even beginning to feel dizzy.

hunks.baseline: *What is he doing? It’s not like he’s pulling a radish out of the ground…*
hunks.sol: *What is he doing? It’s not like he’s pulling radishes out of the ground…*

hunks.baseline: The two men knew how incredibly strong those scales were, which only made them more shocked.
hunks.sol: Both men knew just how durable those scales were, which only made the sight more astonishing.

hunks.sol: The crude Sword Energy of someone who had only just entered the Peak realm could barely cut them. Only Force could reliably split the scales and damage what lay beneath.

hunks.baseline: The scales were that absurdly hard.
hunks.sol: Those bizarre scales were absurdly hard.

hunks.baseline: And yet that young whelp had simply smashed them apart and ripped them off.
hunks.sol: And yet that young whelp was smashing them apart and ripping them off.

hunks.baseline: With nothing but his empty bare hands.
hunks.sol: With nothing but his bare hands.

hunks.baseline: *Did he draw up all of his internal energy? Even so, a human’s physical strength should be nowhere near enough.*
hunks.sol: *Did he draw up every last bit of his internal energy? Even so, a human’s physical strength should be nowhere near enough.*

hunks.baseline: *What the… No, wait. If it’s that bastard, then maybe he can.*
hunks.sol: *What in the… No, wait. That bastard could do it.*

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang, who had watched Jin Taekyung from Shanxi Province until now, found the whole thing both absurd and astonishing.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang, who had watched Jin Taekyung ever since Shanxi Province, found the whole thing absurd—and astonishing.

hunks.baseline: It was not enough that Jin Taekyung had torn out every single whisker, one of the monster’s weapons. Now he had begun stripping away its scales too.
hunks.sol: It was not enough that Jin Taekyung had torn out every whisker, one of the monster’s weapons. Now he had begun stripping away its scales as well.

hunks.baseline: For a martial artist, it was like breaking all their weapons and stripping away the armor worn over their martial uniform.
hunks.sol: For a martial artist, it was like having their weapon broken and the armor over their martial uniform stripped away.

hunks.baseline: But his foundation was entirely different.
hunks.sol: But his very foundation was different.

hunks.baseline: Yet even without the internal energy and martial enlightenment accumulated over several jiazi, he was strong in his own right.
hunks.sol: Yet even if the internal energy and martial insight he had accumulated over several jiazi vanished, he would still be strong in his own right.

hunks.baseline: It was as though the power of the heavens had taken residence inside a human body made of nothing but flesh.
hunks.sol: It was as though the power of heaven had taken residence in a human body made of mere flesh.

hunks.baseline: There was faint astonishment in Mungyeong’s voice.
hunks.sol: Faint astonishment colored Mungyeong’s voice.

hunks.sol: It was a question he had asked himself countless times while they trained in the Fire Gate Cavern. And every time, Jin Taekyung had given him the same infuriatingly shameless answer.

hunks.baseline: Now it was time to give that answer to someone else.
hunks.sol: Now it was time to pass that answer on to someone else.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. The Heavenly Martial Physique.”
hunks.sol: “Yeah. Heavenly Martial Physique.”
